        static float RadioModelo(Model* m)
        {
            float r = 0.05f;
            for (auto& me : m->meshes) for (auto& v : me.vertices) { float l = glm::length(v.Position); r = l > r ? l : r; }
            return r;
        }
        static float EscalaMax(const glm::mat4& M)
        {
            float a = glm::length(glm::vec3(M[0])), b = glm::length(glm::vec3(M[1])), c = glm::length(glm::vec3(M[2]));
            return a > b ? (a > c ? a : c) : (b > c ? b : c);
        }
        // Descarte: no se dibuja lo que esta fuera del campo de vision o tan lejos que la niebla lo oculta
        glm::vec3 cullPos = glm::vec3(0.0f), cullFront = glm::vec3(0.0f, 0.0f, -1.0f);
        float cullAngulo = 1.0f, cullDist = 300.0f;
        bool EnVista(const glm::vec3& c, float r) const
        {
            glm::vec3 v = c - cullPos;
            float dist = glm::length(v);
            if (dist <= r) return true;
            if (dist - r > cullDist) return false;
            float ang = acosf(glm::clamp(glm::dot(v / dist, cullFront), -1.0f, 1.0f));
            return ang < cullAngulo + asinf(r / dist) + 0.05f;
        }
    
        static float MedioLargo(Model* m)
        {
            float mx = 0.01f;
            for (auto& me : m->meshes) for (auto& v : me.vertices) mx = fabsf(v.Position.x) > mx ? fabsf(v.Position.x) : mx;
            return mx;
        }
    
        void CalcularAlturas(Model* t)
        {
            alturas.assign(N * N, 0.0f);
            for (auto& me : t->meshes) for (auto& v : me.vertices) {
                int i = (int)roundf((v.Position.x + 55.0f) / 110.0f * (N - 1));
                int j = (int)roundf((v.Position.z + 55.0f) / 110.0f * (N - 1));
                if (i >= 0 && i < N && j >= 0 && j < N) alturas[j * N + i] = v.Position.y;
            }
        }
    
        // Matriz de modelo de un miembro k del elemento en el tiempo t
        glm::mat4 Matriz(const Elemento& e, int idx, int k, float t) const
        {
            glm::vec3 p = e.pos, dir(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
            bool orientar = false;
            float signo = e.vel >= 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
            glm::vec3 off = k > 0 ? Aleatorio3(idx * 97 + k) * e.dispersion : glm::vec3(0.0f);
            float yawUsar = e.yaw;
            glm::vec3 rotUsar = e.rotExtra;
            float escUsar = e.escala;
            switch (e.mov) {
            case MOV_FIJO:
                p.y += e.baseY + sinf(t * e.oscVel + e.fase) * e.oscAmp;
                if (k > 0) { p += glm::vec3(off.x, 0.0f, off.z); yawUsar += k * 137.5f; }   // copias esparcidas (monedas)
                break;

                break;
            case MOV_ORBITA:
            case MOV_CARDUMEN: {

        void ReadNodeHierarchy(float AnimationTime, const aiNode* pNode, const glm::mat4& ParentTransform)
        {
            if (pNode == nullptr || scene == nullptr || scene->mNumAnimations == 0) return;
    
            string NodeName(pNode->mName.data);
    
            const aiAnimation* pAnimation = scene->mAnimations[0];
    
            //cout << NodeName << endl;
    
            if (pAnimation == nullptr) return;
    
            //cout << "valid animation" << endl;
    
            //aiMatrix4x4 NodeTransformation(pNode->mTransformation);
            aiMatrix4x4 NodeTransformation;
    
            const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim = FindNodeAnim(pAnimation, NodeName);
    
            if (pNodeAnim != nullptr) {
                aiVector3D Scaling;
                CalcInterpolatedScaling(Scaling, AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
                aiMatrix4x4 ScalingM;
                if (ScalingM.IsIdentity())
                    aiMatrix4x4::Scaling(Scaling, ScalingM);
    
                aiQuaternion RotationQ;
                CalcInterpolatedRotation(RotationQ, AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
                aiMatrix4x4 RotationM(RotationQ.GetMatrix());
    
                aiVector3D Translation;
                CalcInterpolatedPosition(Translation, AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
                aiMatrix4x4 TranslationM;
                if (ScalingM.IsIdentity())
                    aiMatrix4x4::Translation(Translation, TranslationM);
    
                // Combine the above transformations
                NodeTransformation = TranslationM * RotationM * ScalingM;
    
                // cout << "Compute Node Transformation: " << pNodeAnim->mNodeName.data << endl;
            }
    
            glm::mat4 GlobalTransformation = ParentTransform * aiMatrix4x4ToGlm(NodeTransformation);
    
            //cout << "GT=" << glm::to_string(GlobalTransformation) << endl;
    
            // cout << "Parent: " << NodeName << endl;
    
            // Modify bones transformation
            for (unsigned int b = 0; b < bones.size(); b++) {
                if (bones[b].name == pNode->mName) {
                    bones[b].transformation =  m_GlobalInverseTransform * GlobalTransformation*bones[b].offsetMatrix;
                    //cout << "bone: " << b << " : " << bones[b].name.data << " T= " << glm::to_string(bones[b].transformation) << endl;
                }
            }
    
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < pNode->mNumChildren; i++) {
                // cout << "Child: " << pNode->mChildren[i]->mName.data << ": " << i << endl;
                ReadNodeHierarchy(AnimationTime, pNode->mChildren[i], GlobalTransformation);
            }
        }
    
        const aiNodeAnim* FindNodeAnim(const aiAnimation* pAnimation, const string NodeName)
        {
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < pAnimation->mNumChannels; i++) {
                const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim = pAnimation->mChannels[i];
    
                if (string(pNodeAnim->mNodeName.data) == NodeName) {
                    return pNodeAnim;
                }
            }
    
            return nullptr;
        }
    
    
        void CalcInterpolatedScaling(aiVector3D& Out, float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            if (pNodeAnim->mNumScalingKeys == 1) {
                Out = pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[0].mValue;
                return;
            }
    
            unsigned int ScalingIndex = FindScaling(AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
            unsigned int NextScalingIndex = (ScalingIndex + 1);
            assert(NextScalingIndex < pNodeAnim->mNumScalingKeys);
            float DeltaTime = (float)(pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[NextScalingIndex].mTime - pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[ScalingIndex].mTime);
            float Factor = (AnimationTime - (float)pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[ScalingIndex].mTime) / DeltaTime;
            assert(Factor >= 0.0f && Factor <= 1.0f);
            const aiVector3D& Start = pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[ScalingIndex].mValue;
            const aiVector3D& End = pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[NextScalingIndex].mValue;
            aiVector3D Delta = End - Start;
            Out = Start + Factor * Delta;
        }
    
        unsigned int FindScaling(float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            assert(pNodeAnim->mNumScalingKeys > 0);
    
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < pNodeAnim->mNumScalingKeys - 1; i++) {
                if (AnimationTime < (float)pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[i + 1].mTime) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
    #version 330 core
    // Objetos de las zonas: ondulacion del cuerpo al nadar y vaiven de algas.
    layout (location = 0) in vec3 aPos;
    layout (location = 1) in vec3 aNormal;
    layout (location = 2) in vec2 aTexCoords;
    layout (location = 5) in vec4 bIDs1;
    layout (location = 6) in vec4 bIDs2;
    layout (location = 7) in vec4 bIDs3;
    layout (location = 8) in vec4 bWeights1;
    layout (location = 9) in vec4 bWeights2;
    layout (location = 10) in vec4 bWeights3;
    
    uniform mat4 model;
    uniform mat4 view;
    uniform mat4 projection;
    
    uniform float uTiempo;
    uniform float uOndula;    // amplitud de la ondulacion (metros); 0 = rigido
    uniform float uLargo;     // medio largo del modelo (la cabeza esta en +X)
    uniform float uVelNado;   // velocidad de la ondulacion
    uniform float uMecer;     // vaiven de algas y abanicos
    uniform float uFase;
    uniform int   uOndulaEje;  // 0 = cola de lado a lado (peces), 1 = de arriba a abajo (mamiferos)
    uniform int   uSkinning;   // 1 = aplicar huesos de la armadura
    uniform mat4  gBones[100];
    
    out vec3 vPosMundo;
    out vec3 vNormal;
    out vec2 vUV;
    
    void main()
    {
        vec3 p = aPos;
        vec3 normal = aNormal;
        if (uSkinning != 0) {
            mat4 huesos = gBones[int(bIDs1[0])] * bWeights1[0];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs1[1])] * bWeights1[1];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs1[2])] * bWeights1[2];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs1[3])] * bWeights1[3];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs2[0])] * bWeights2[0];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs2[1])] * bWeights2[1];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs2[2])] * bWeights2[2];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs2[3])] * bWeights2[3];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs3[0])] * bWeights3[0];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs3[1])] * bWeights3[1];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs3[2])] * bWeights3[2];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs3[3])] * bWeights3[3];
            float peso = dot(bWeights1, vec4(1.0)) + dot(bWeights2, vec4(1.0)) + dot(bWeights3, vec4(1.0));
            if (peso > 0.0001) {
                huesos *= 1.0 / peso;
                p = (huesos * vec4(aPos, 1.0)).xyz;
                normal = mat3(huesos) * aNormal;
            }
        }
        if (uOndula > 0.0) {
            // 0 en la cabeza, 1 en la cola: la cola se mueve mas que la cabeza
            float t = clamp((uLargo - p.x) / (2.0 * uLargo), 0.0, 1.0);
            float w = uOndula * pow(t, 1.6) * uLargo;
            float onda = w * sin(p.x / uLargo * 3.0 - uTiempo * uVelNado + uFase);
            if (uOndulaEje == 1) p.y += onda; else p.z += onda;
        }
        if (uMecer > 0.0) {
            float h = max(p.y, 0.0);
            p.x += sin(uTiempo * 0.9 + uFase + h * 0.7) * uMecer * h * 0.10;
            p.z += cos(uTiempo * 0.7 + uFase + h * 0.5) * uMecer * h * 0.07;
        }
        vec4 mundo = model * vec4(p, 1.0);
        vPosMundo = mundo.xyz;
        vNormal = normalize(mat3(transpose(inverse(model))) * normal);
        vUV = aTexCoords;
        gl_Position = projection * view * mundo;
    }

        bool renderFramebufferToTexture() {
            //glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    
            glDeleteTextures(1, &texture_gl);
            glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &framebuffer_gl);
            glDeleteRenderbuffers(1, &rbo_gl);
            glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
            // Generate texture
            glGenTextures(1, &texture_gl);
            glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, texture_gl);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_REPEAT);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_REPEAT);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);

            glGenRenderbuffers(1, &rbo_gl);
            glBindRenderbuffer(GL_RENDERBUFFER, rbo_gl);
            glRenderbufferStorage(GL_RENDERBUFFER, GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8, 1024, 768);
    
    
            glGenFramebuffers(1, &framebuffer_gl);
            glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, framebuffer_gl);
            glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, GL_TEXTURE_2D, texture_gl, 0);
            glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, GL_RENDERBUFFER, rbo_gl);
            glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT, GL_RENDERBUFFER, rbo_gl);
    
            GLenum status = glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER);
            if (status != GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE)
            {
                // Restore current framebuffer
                glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
                return false;

        void processNode(aiNode *node, float time){
    
            if (node == nullptr) return;
    
            glm::mat4 n_matrix(1.0f);
            ReadNodeHierarchy(time, node, n_matrix);

        // processes a node in a recursive fashion. Processes each individual mesh located at the node and repeats this process on its children nodes (if any).
        void processNode(aiNode *node, const aiScene *scene)
        {
            // cout << node->mName.data << endl;
            // cout << "Meshes: " << node->mNumMeshes << endl;
            // process each mesh located at the current node
            for(unsigned int i = 0; i < node->mNumMeshes; i++)
            {
                // the node object only contains indices to index the actual objects in the scene.
                // the scene contains all the data, node is just to keep stuff organized (like relations between nodes).
                aiMesh* mesh = scene->mMeshes[node->mMeshes[i]];
                // cout << "Mesh: " << mesh->mName.data << endl;
                meshes.push_back(processMesh(mesh, scene));
            }
            // after we've processed all of the meshes (if any) we then recursively process each of the children nodes
            for(unsigned int i = 0; i < node->mNumChildren; i++)
            {
                processNode(node->mChildren[i], scene);
            }
    
        }
    
        Mesh processMesh(aiMesh *mesh, const aiScene *scene)
        {
            // data to fill
            vector<Vertex> vertices;
            vector<unsigned int> indices;
            vector<Texture> textures;
    
            // cout << "NumVertices: " << mesh->mNumVertices << endl;
    
            // Bones: registrar el esqueleto antes de los vertices para usar indices globales.
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < mesh->mNumBones; i++) {
                string bname(mesh->mBones[i]->mName.data);
                if (m_BoneMapping.count(bname)) continue;
    
                Bone newBone;
                newBone.name = mesh->mBones[i]->mName;
                newBone.offsetMatrix = aiMatrix4x4ToGlm(mesh->mBones[i]->mOffsetMatrix);
                newBone.transformation = glm::mat4(1.0f);
                for (unsigned int j = 0; j < mesh->mBones[i]->mNumWeights; j++)
                    newBone.push(mesh->mBones[i]->mWeights[j].mVertexId, mesh->mBones[i]->mWeights[j].mWeight);
    
                m_BoneMapping[bname] = (unsigned int)bones.size();
                bones.push_back(newBone);
            }
    
            // Walk through each of the mesh's vertices
            for(unsigned int i = 0; i < mesh->mNumVertices; i++)
            {
                Vertex vertex;
                glm::vec3 vector; // we declare a placeholder vector since assimp uses its own vector class that doesn't directly convert to glm's vec3 class so we transfer the data to this placeholder glm::vec3 first.
                // positions
                vector.x = mesh->mVertices[i].x;
                vector.y = mesh->mVertices[i].y;
                vector.z = mesh->mVertices[i].z;
                vertex.Position = vector;
                // normals
                if (mesh->mNormals) {
                    vector.x = mesh->mNormals[i].x;
                    vector.y = mesh->mNormals[i].y;
                    vector.z = mesh->mNormals[i].z;
                } else vector = glm::vec3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
                vertex.Normal = vector;
                // texture coordinates
                if(mesh->mTextureCoords[0]) // does the mesh contain texture coordinates?
                {
                    glm::vec2 vec;
                    // a vertex can contain up to 8 different texture coordinates. We thus make the assumption that we won't
                    // use models where a vertex can have multiple texture coordinates so we always take the first set (0).
                    vec.x = mesh->mTextureCoords[0][i].x;
                    vec.y = mesh->mTextureCoords[0][i].y;
                    vertex.TexCoords = vec;
                }
                else
                    vertex.TexCoords = glm::vec2(0.0f, 0.0f);
                // tangent
                if (mesh->mTangents && mesh->mBitangents) {   // solo existen si el modelo tiene UV
                    vector.x = mesh->mTangents[i].x;
                    vector.y = mesh->mTangents[i].y;
                    vector.z = mesh->mTangents[i].z;
                    vertex.Tangent = vector;
                    vector.x = mesh->mBitangents[i].x;
                    vector.y = mesh->mBitangents[i].y;
                    vector.z = mesh->mBitangents[i].z;
                    vertex.Bitangent = vector;
                } else {
                    vertex.Tangent = glm::vec3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
                    vertex.Bitangent = glm::vec3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                }
    
                // Bones
                int bcount = 0;
                for (unsigned int pb = 0; pb < MAX_NUM_BONES; pb++) {
                    vertex.IDs1[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.IDs2[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.IDs3[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.Weights1[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.Weights2[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.Weights3[pb] = 0.0f;
                }
                m_NumBones = mesh->mNumBones;
                for (unsigned int j = 0; j < mesh->mNumBones; j++) {
                    string bname(mesh->mBones[j]->mName.data);
                    auto bit = m_BoneMapping.find(bname);
                    if (bit == m_BoneMapping.end()) continue;
                    float gId = (float)bit->second;
    
                    for (unsigned int k = 0; k < mesh->mBones[j]->mNumWeights; k++) {
                        unsigned int VertexID = mesh->mBones[j]->mWeights[k].mVertexId;
                        float Weight = (float)(mesh->mBones[j]->mWeights[k].mWeight);
                        if ( VertexID == i && bcount < MAX_NUM_BONES ) {
                            vertex.IDs1[bcount] = gId;
                            vertex.Weights1[bcount] = Weight;
                            bcount++;
                        }
                        if (VertexID == i && bcount >= MAX_NUM_BONES && bcount < 2*MAX_NUM_BONES) {
                            vertex.IDs2[bcount - MAX_NUM_BONES] = gId;
                            vertex.Weights2[bcount - MAX_NUM_BONES] = Weight;
                            bcount++;
                        }
                        if (VertexID == i && bcount >= 2 * MAX_NUM_BONES && bcount < 3 * MAX_NUM_BONES) {
                            vertex.IDs3[bcount - 2*MAX_NUM_BONES] = gId;
                            vertex.Weights3[bcount - 2*MAX_NUM_BONES] = Weight;
                            bcount++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                vertices.push_back(vertex);
                //cout << "Vertex " << i << ": " << glm::to_string(vertex.IDs1) << glm::to_string(vertex.IDs2) << glm::to_string(vertex.IDs3)  << endl;
                //cout << "Vertex " << i << ": " << glm::to_string(vertex.Weights1) << glm::to_string(vertex.Weights2) << glm::to_string(vertex.Weights3) << endl;
            }
            // cout << "Vertex readed: " << vertices.size() << endl;
    
            // cout << "NumFaces: " << mesh->mNumFaces << endl;
    
            // now wak through each of the mesh's faces (a face is a mesh its triangle) and retrieve the corresponding vertex indices.
            for(unsigned int i = 0; i < mesh->mNumFaces; i++)
            {
            }
            textures.insert(textures.end(), diffuseMaps.begin(), diffuseMaps.end());
            // 2. specular maps
            vector<Texture> specularMaps = loadMaterialTextures(material, aiTextureType_SPECULAR, "texture_specular");
            textures.insert(textures.end(), specularMaps.begin(), specularMaps.end());
            // 3. normal maps
            std::vector<Texture> normalMaps = loadMaterialTextures(material, aiTextureType_HEIGHT, "texture_normal");
            textures.insert(textures.end(), normalMaps.begin(), normalMaps.end());
            // 4. height maps
            std::vector<Texture> heightMaps = loadMaterialTextures(material, aiTextureType_AMBIENT, "texture_height");
            textures.insert(textures.end(), heightMaps.begin(), heightMaps.end());
    
            // return a mesh object created from the extracted mesh data
            return Mesh(vertices, indices, textures);
        }
    
        void ReadNodeHierarchy(float AnimationTime, const aiNode* pNode, const glm::mat4& ParentTransform)
        {
            if (pNode == nullptr || scene == nullptr || scene->mNumAnimations == 0) return;
    
            string NodeName(pNode->mName.data);
    
            const aiAnimation* pAnimation = scene->mAnimations[0];
    
            //cout << NodeName << endl;
    
            if (pAnimation == nullptr) return;
    
            //cout << "valid animation" << endl;
    
            //aiMatrix4x4 NodeTransformation(pNode->mTransformation);
            aiMatrix4x4 NodeTransformation;
    
            const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim = FindNodeAnim(pAnimation, NodeName);
    
            if (pNodeAnim != nullptr) {
                aiVector3D Scaling;
                CalcInterpolatedScaling(Scaling, AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
                aiMatrix4x4 ScalingM;
                if (ScalingM.IsIdentity())
                    aiMatrix4x4::Scaling(Scaling, ScalingM);
    
                aiQuaternion RotationQ;
                CalcInterpolatedRotation(RotationQ, AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
                aiMatrix4x4 RotationM(RotationQ.GetMatrix());
    
                aiVector3D Translation;
                CalcInterpolatedPosition(Translation, AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
                aiMatrix4x4 TranslationM;
                if (ScalingM.IsIdentity())
                    aiMatrix4x4::Translation(Translation, TranslationM);
    
                // Combine the above transformations
                NodeTransformation = TranslationM * RotationM * ScalingM;
    
                // cout << "Compute Node Transformation: " << pNodeAnim->mNodeName.data << endl;
            }
    
            glm::mat4 GlobalTransformation = ParentTransform * aiMatrix4x4ToGlm(NodeTransformation);
    
            //cout << "GT=" << glm::to_string(GlobalTransformation) << endl;
    
            // cout << "Parent: " << NodeName << endl;
    
            // Modify bones transformation
            for (unsigned int b = 0; b < bones.size(); b++) {
                if (bones[b].name == pNode->mName) {
                    bones[b].transformation =  m_GlobalInverseTransform * GlobalTransformation*bones[b].offsetMatrix;
                    //cout << "bone: " << b << " : " << bones[b].name.data << " T= " << glm::to_string(bones[b].transformation) << endl;
                }
            }
    
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < pNode->mNumChildren; i++) {
                // cout << "Child: " << pNode->mChildren[i]->mName.data << ": " << i << endl;
                ReadNodeHierarchy(AnimationTime, pNode->mChildren[i], GlobalTransformation);
            }
        }
    
        const aiNodeAnim* FindNodeAnim(const aiAnimation* pAnimation, const string NodeName)
        {
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < pAnimation->mNumChannels; i++) {
                const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim = pAnimation->mChannels[i];
    
                if (string(pNodeAnim->mNodeName.data) == NodeName) {
                    return pNodeAnim;
                }
            }
    
            return nullptr;
        }
    
    
        void CalcInterpolatedScaling(aiVector3D& Out, float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            if (pNodeAnim->mNumScalingKeys == 1) {
                Out = pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[0].mValue;
                return;
            }
    
            unsigned int ScalingIndex = FindScaling(AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
            unsigned int NextScalingIndex = (ScalingIndex + 1);
            assert(NextScalingIndex < pNodeAnim->mNumScalingKeys);
            float DeltaTime = (float)(pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[NextScalingIndex].mTime - pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[ScalingIndex].mTime);
            float Factor = (AnimationTime - (float)pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[ScalingIndex].mTime) / DeltaTime;
            assert(Factor >= 0.0f && Factor <= 1.0f);
            const aiVector3D& Start = pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[ScalingIndex].mValue;
            const aiVector3D& End = pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[NextScalingIndex].mValue;
            aiVector3D Delta = End - Start;
            Out = Start + Factor * Delta;
        }
    
        unsigned int FindScaling(float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            assert(pNodeAnim->mNumScalingKeys > 0);
    
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < pNodeAnim->mNumScalingKeys - 1; i++) {
                if (AnimationTime < (float)pNodeAnim->mScalingKeys[i + 1].mTime) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
    
            assert(0);
    
            return 0;
        }
    
        void CalcInterpolatedRotation(aiQuaternion& Out, float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            // we need at least two values to interpolate...
            if (pNodeAnim->mNumRotationKeys == 1) {
                Out = pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[0].mValue;
                return;
            }
    
            unsigned int RotationIndex = FindRotation(AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
            unsigned int NextRotationIndex = (RotationIndex + 1);
            assert(NextRotationIndex < pNodeAnim->mNumRotationKeys);
            float DeltaTime = (float)(pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[NextRotationIndex].mTime - pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[RotationIndex].mTime);
            float Factor = (AnimationTime - (float)pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[RotationIndex].mTime) / DeltaTime;
            assert(Factor >= 0.0f && Factor <= 1.0f);
            const aiQuaternion& StartRotationQ = pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[RotationIndex].mValue;
            const aiQuaternion& EndRotationQ = pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[NextRotationIndex].mValue;
            aiQuaternion::Interpolate(Out, StartRotationQ, EndRotationQ, Factor);
            Out = Out.Normalize();
        }

    #ifndef MODEL_H
    #define MODEL_H
    
    #include <glm/gtx/string_cast.hpp>
    
    #include <modelstructs.h>
    
    class Model
    {
    public:
        /*  Model Data */
        vector<Texture> textures_loaded;    // stores all the textures loaded so far, optimization to make sure textures aren't loaded more than once.
        vector<Mesh> meshes;
        string directory;
        bool gammaCorrection;
    
        string filename;
    
        /* Bones data */
        vector<Bone> bones;
    
        static const int MAX_BONES_MODEL = 100;
        glm::mat4 m_Bones[MAX_BONES_MODEL];
        unsigned int m_BoneShaderID = 0;
        GLint m_BoneLocations[MAX_BONES_MODEL];
        double m_AnimDuracion = 0.0;
        double m_AnimFps = 24.0;
    
        /* Scene data */
        Assimp::Importer importer;
        const aiScene* scene;
    
        map<string, unsigned int> m_BoneMapping; // maps a bone name to its index
        unsigned int m_NumBones;
        vector<BoneInfo> m_BoneInfo;
        glm::mat4 m_GlobalInverseTransform;
        unsigned int texture_gl;
        unsigned int rbo_gl;
    
    private:
    
        /*  Functions   */
    
        inline glm::mat4 aiMatrix4x4ToGlm(aiMatrix4x4 from)
        {
            glm::mat4 to;
    
            to[0][0] = (GLfloat)from.a1; to[0][1] = (GLfloat)from.b1;  to[0][2] = (GLfloat)from.c1; to[0][3] = (GLfloat)from.d1;
            to[1][0] = (GLfloat)from.a2; to[1][1] = (GLfloat)from.b2;  to[1][2] = (GLfloat)from.c2; to[1][3] = (GLfloat)from.d2;
            to[2][0] = (GLfloat)from.a3; to[2][1] = (GLfloat)from.b3;  to[2][2] = (GLfloat)from.c3; to[2][3] = (GLfloat)from.d3;
            to[3][0] = (GLfloat)from.a4; to[3][1] = (GLfloat)from.b4;  to[3][2] = (GLfloat)from.c4; to[3][3] = (GLfloat)from.d4;
    
            return to;
        }
    
        // loads a model with supported ASSIMP extensions from file and stores the resulting meshes in the meshes vector.
        void loadModel(string const &path)
        {
            // read file via ASSIMP
            scene = importer.ReadFile(path, aiProcess_Triangulate | aiProcess_GenSmoothNormals | aiProcess_FlipUVs | aiProcess_CalcTangentSpace);  // GenSmoothNormals: crea normales si el FBX no las trae
            // check for errors
            if(!scene || scene->mFlags & AI_SCENE_FLAGS_INCOMPLETE || !scene->mRootNode) // if is Not Zero
            {
                cout << "ERROR::ASSIMP:: " << importer.GetErrorString() << endl;
                return;
            }
            filename = path;
            // retrieve the directory path of the filepath
            directory = path.substr(0, path.find_last_of('/'));
    
            aiMatrix4x4 inverseTransform = scene->mRootNode->mTransformation;
            inverseTransform.Inverse();
            m_GlobalInverseTransform = aiMatrix4x4ToGlm(inverseTransform);
    
            m_BoneMapping.clear();
            bones.clear();
            m_AnimDuracion = 0.0;
            m_AnimFps = 24.0;
            if (scene->mNumAnimations > 0) {
                const aiAnimation* anim = scene->mAnimations[0];
                if (anim) {
                    m_AnimDuracion = anim->mDuration;
                    if (anim->mTicksPerSecond > 0.0) m_AnimFps = anim->mTicksPerSecond;
                }
            }
    
            // process ASSIMP's root node recursively
            processNode(scene->mRootNode, scene);

    void EntrarZona(int zona)
    {
        estadoActual = (Estado)zona;
        escenario.CerrarInspeccion();
        ambienteInspeccionPausado = false;
    
        // Carga la zona (la primera vez lee sus modelos) y coloca al buzo en su punto de inicio
        escenario.Entrar(zona, camera);
        if (zona == ARRECIFES) arrecife.Reiniciar(escenario);
        if (zona == AGUAS_FRIAS) aguasFrias.Reiniciar(escenario);
        if (zona == NAUFRAGIOS) naufragio.Reiniciar(escenario, animTime);
        const char* ambientes[] = { "", "sound/ambiente_arrecife.wav", "sound/ambiente_frio.wav", "sound/ambiente_naufragio.wav" };
        Ambiente(ambientes[zona], silencio ? 0.0f : 0.6f);
        diverVelocity = glm::vec3(0.0f);
        firstMouse = true;
        pickedFish = -1;
        zonaTiempo = 0.0f;
        modoOrbita = false;
        orbitDist = 6.0f;
        escenario.modoEdicion = false;
        escenario.editIdx = -1;
        lastFrame = (float)glfwGetTime();   // la carga no cuenta como tiempo de nado
    
        // El cursor desaparece: el centro de la pantalla es la mira del buzo
        glfwSetInputMode(window, GLFW_CURSOR, GLFW_CURSOR_DISABLED);
    
        zonaFade = 1.0f;   // la zona aparece desde negro
        glPolygonMode(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_FILL);
    
        std::string titulo = std::string("Acuario Virtual Interactivo - ") + nombresZona[zona];
        glfwSetWindowTitle(window, titulo.c_str());
        std::cout << ">> Entrando a " << nombresZona[zona] << " (Esc para volver al menu)" << std::endl;
    }

    #ifndef ZONAS_H
    #define ZONAS_H
    /*
    * Zonas de inmersion del Acuario Virtual Interactivo.
    *
    *   Zona 1 - Arrecifes    : agua calida y clara, corales de colores, causticas fuertes
    *   Zona 2 - Aguas Frias  : agua palida, plataformas de hielo, ballena, focas, pinguinos
    *   Zona 3 - Naufragios   : agua oscura y turbia, submarino, ruinas, basura, linterna
    *
    * Cada zona es una lista de "Elementos" (modelo + como se mueve). Para agregar un
    * animal u objeto basta con agregar un Elemento en ConstruirArrecifes(),
    * ConstruirAguasFrias() o ConstruirNaufragios().
    *
    * Los modelos se exportan desde Blender con herramientas/exporta_zonas.py:
    * todos miran a +X, el lomo hacia +Y, y miden su tamano real en metros.
    *
    * Shaders: shaders/zona.vs/.fs (objetos), shaders/zona_fondo.fs (agua de fondo),
    *          shaders/zona_superficie.vs/.fs (superficie del agua vista desde abajo).
    */

    enum TipoMov {
        MOV_FIJO,       // quieto (puede flotar suavemente con oscAmp)
        MOV_ORBITA,     // nada en circulo alrededor de pos
        MOV_CARDUMEN,   // grupo de 'miembros' que nadan juntos en circulo
        MOV_LIBRE,      // recorrido en forma de 8 (animales grandes)
        MOV_DERIVA,     // flota a la deriva girando lentamente (basura)
        MOV_KF          // animacion por cuadros clave (Elemento::kf)
    };
    
    struct Elemento {
        std::string archivo;               // modelo sin extension (models/zonas/<carpeta>/<archivo>.fbx)
        std::string carpeta;               // arrecifes, aguas_frias, naufragios o comun
        TipoMov mov = MOV_FIJO;
        glm::vec3 pos = glm::vec3(0.0f);   // posicion o centro de la orbita
        float yaw = 0.0f;                  // giro en Y (grados) para elementos fijos
        glm::vec3 rotExtra = glm::vec3(0.0f); // giro adicional en X, Y, Z (grados)
        float escala = 1.0f;
        glm::vec3 tinte = glm::vec3(1.0f); // se multiplica por la textura
        float radio = 0.0f, vel = 0.0f, fase = 0.0f;
        float oscAmp = 0.0f, oscVel = 1.0f; // oscilacion vertical
        float ondula = 0.0f, velNado = 6.0f; // ondulacion del cuerpo al nadar
        float mecer = 0.0f;                // vaiven de algas
        int miembros = 1;                  // para cardumenes
        float dispersion = 1.5f;
        bool sobreSuelo = false;           // pos.y se mide desde el terreno
        bool interactivo = false;
        bool basura = false;
        std::string etiqueta;              // nombre para el HUD (textures/menu/etiquetas/<etiqueta>.png)
        float alpha = 1.0f, emision = 0.0f;
        // material Phong diferenciado (opaco = defaults)
        float specInt = 0.25f, specPower = 40.0f, metalico = 0.0f;
        // animacion por cuadros clave (MOV_KF); apunta a un AnimacionKF con duracion estable
        const AnimacionKF* kf = nullptr;
        bool visible = true;
        // mecanicas
        bool esCoral = false;              // se blanquea con la temperatura (corales, anemonas, almejas)
        float sensibilidad = 1.0f;         // que tan rapido se estresa con el calor
        float estres = 0.0f;               // estres termico acumulado (0 = sano, 1 = blanqueado)
        float blanqueo = 0.0f;             // 0..1 visual
        float muerte = 0.0f;               // 0..1 visual (coral muerto cubierto de algas)
        float presencia = 1.0f;            // fraccion visible de un cardumen
        bool inflable = false;             // pez globo: se infla si el buzo se acerca
        float inflado = 0.0f;
        bool camuflaje = false;            // pulpo: cambia de color
        bool ondulaVertical = false;       // mamiferos: mueven la cola de arriba a abajo
        int residuo = 0;                   // Zona 3: 0 no es basura, 1 plastico, 2 metal, 3 toxico, 4 red
        float peso = 1.0f;                 // cuanto aporta a la limpieza del agua
        bool invasor = false;              // especie invasora que se puede retirar
        bool pulsar = false;               // medusa: la campana se contrae y se expande
        float fantasma = 0.0f;             // brillo de borde tipo Fresnel (traslucidos)
        float kfInicio = 0.0f;             // MOV_KF: segundo en que empieza la animacion
        // calculado al cargar
        Model* modelo = nullptr;
        unsigned int id = 0;
        float medioLargo = 0.5f;
        float radioBase = 1.0f;            // radio de la esfera envolvente del modelo (sin escala)
        float baseY = 0.0f;
    };

        bool Init(unsigned int cubemapID)

            glBindVertexArray(0);
            return true;
        }
    
        // Prepara la zona (carga sus modelos la primera vez) y coloca la camara.
        void Entrar(int z, Camera& cam)
        {
            zona = z;
            elementos.clear(); burbujas.clear(); animaciones.clear(); monedasVuelo.clear(); seleccion = -1;
            // terreno primero: los elementos se colocan sobre el al construirse
            const char* terrenos[] = { "", "terreno_arrecifes", "terreno_aguas_frias", "terreno_naufragios" };
            const char* carpetas[] = { "", "arrecifes", "aguas_frias", "naufragios" };
            terreno = Cargar(terrenos[z], carpetas[z]);
            CalcularAlturas(terreno);
            if (z == 1) ConstruirArrecifes();
            else if (z == 2) ConstruirAguasFrias();
            else ConstruirNaufragios();
    
            // terreno primero: los demas elementos se apoyan en el
            terreno = Cargar(terrenoArchivo, terrenoCarpeta);
            CalcularAlturas(terreno);
            basuraTotal = 0; basuraRecogida = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < elementos.size(); i++) {
                Elemento& e = elementos[i];
                e.modelo = Cargar(e.archivo, e.carpeta);
                e.medioLargo = MedioLargo(e.modelo);
                e.radioBase = RadioModelo(e.modelo);
                e.id = 1000 + (unsigned int)i;
                e.baseY = e.sobreSuelo ? AlturaSuelo(e.pos.x, e.pos.z) : 0.0f;
                if (e.basura) basuraTotal++;
            }
            burbujaModelo = Cargar("burbuja", "comun");
            cfgBase = cfg;
            for (auto& f : fuentes) f.y += AlturaSuelo(f.x, f.z);   // las fuentes se miden desde el fondo
            linterna = cfg.linterna;
    
            cam.Position = cfg.inicioCamara;
            cam.Yaw = cfg.inicioYaw; cam.Pitch = -5.0f; cam.Zoom = ZOOM;
            cam.ProcessMouseMovement(0.0f, 0.0f);
        }
    
        // Altura del fondo marino en (x, z), interpolada del terreno cargado.
        float AlturaSuelo(float x, float z) const
        {
            if (alturas.empty()) return 0.0f;
            float fx = (x + 55.0f) / 110.0f * (N - 1), fz = (z + 55.0f) / 110.0f * (N - 1);
            fx = fx < 0 ? 0 : (fx > N - 1.001f ? N - 1.001f : fx);
            fz = fz < 0 ? 0 : (fz > N - 1.001f ? N - 1.001f : fz);
            int i = (int)fx, j = (int)fz; float u = fx - i, v = fz - j;
            float a = alturas[j * N + i], b = alturas[j * N + i + 1], c = alturas[(j + 1) * N + i], d = alturas[(j + 1) * N + i + 1];
            return (a * (1 - u) + b * u) * (1 - v) + (c * (1 - u) + d * u) * v;
        }
    
        // Burbujas y animaciones. 'exhala' agrega las burbujas del regulador del buzo.
        std::vector<Elemento>& Elementos() { return elementos; }
    
        // Lanza 'n' monedas desde 'origen' como una fuente que cae girando al fondo (cofre del tesoro)
        void LanzarMonedas(const glm::vec3& origen, int n)
        {
            if (!modeloMoneda) modeloMoneda = Cargar("moneda", "naufragios");
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                glm::vec3 r = Aleatorio3(i * 7 + (int)monedasVuelo.size());
                float ang = Aleatorio(i, 31) * 6.2832f, abre = 0.6f + 1.8f * Aleatorio(i, 32);
                MonedaVoladora m;
                m.p = origen + glm::vec3(r.x * 0.25f, Aleatorio(i, 33) * 0.2f, r.z * 0.15f);
                m.v = glm::vec3(cosf(ang) * abre, 3.2f + 2.6f * Aleatorio(i, 34), sinf(ang) * abre + 0.6f);
                m.eje = glm::normalize(glm::vec3(r.x, 0.3f + fabsf(r.y), r.z) + glm::vec3(0.001f));
                m.ang = 0.0f; m.vAng = 6.0f + 10.0f * Aleatorio(i, 35); m.brillo = Aleatorio(i, 36) * 6.28f; m.quieta = false;
                monedasVuelo.push_back(m);
            }
        }

        // Devuelve true en el cuadro en que el buzo exhala (para el sonido de burbujas)
        bool Actualizar(float dt, float t, const Camera& cam)
        {
            if (dt > 0.1f) dt = 0.1f;
            bool exhalo = false;
            for (MonedaVoladora& m : monedasVuelo) {
                if (m.quieta) continue;
                m.v.y -= 2.4f * dt;                         // bajo el agua caen despacio
                m.v *= expf(-0.7f * dt);
                m.p += m.v * dt; m.ang += m.vAng * dt;
                float suelo = AlturaSuelo(m.p.x, m.p.z) + 0.02f;
                if (m.p.y <= suelo && m.v.y < 0.0f) {      // al tocar el fondo quedan acostadas
                    m.p.y = suelo; m.quieta = true; m.eje = glm::vec3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
                }
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; i < elementos.size(); i++) {
                Elemento& e = elementos[i];
                if (!e.inflable) continue;
                glm::vec3 p = glm::vec3(Matriz(e, (int)i, 0, t)[3]);
                float objetivo = glm::length(p - cam.Position) < 3.5f ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
                e.inflado += (objetivo - e.inflado) * (dt * (objetivo > e.inflado ? 4.0f : 0.8f));
    
            return 0;
        }
    
        void CalcInterpolatedRotation(aiQuaternion& Out, float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            if (AnimationTime <= (float)pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[0].mTime) { Out = pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[0].mValue; return; }
            if (AnimationTime >= (float)pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[pNodeAnim->mNumRotationKeys - 1].mTime) { Out = pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[pNodeAnim->mNumRotationKeys - 1].mValue; return; }
            // we need at least two values to interpolate...
            if (pNodeAnim->mNumRotationKeys == 1) {
                Out = pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[0].mValue;
                return;
            }
    
            unsigned int RotationIndex = FindRotation(AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
            unsigned int NextRotationIndex = (RotationIndex + 1);
            assert(NextRotationIndex < pNodeAnim->mNumRotationKeys);
            float DeltaTime = (float)(pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[NextRotationIndex].mTime - pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[RotationIndex].mTime);
            float Factor = (AnimationTime - (float)pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[RotationIndex].mTime) / DeltaTime;
            assert(Factor >= 0.0f && Factor <= 1.0f);
            const aiQuaternion& StartRotationQ = pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[RotationIndex].mValue;
            const aiQuaternion& EndRotationQ = pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[NextRotationIndex].mValue;
            aiQuaternion::Interpolate(Out, StartRotationQ, EndRotationQ, Factor);
            Out = Out.Normalize();
        }
    
        unsigned int FindRotation(float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            assert(pNodeAnim->mNumRotationKeys > 0);
    
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < pNodeAnim->mNumRotationKeys - 1; i++) {
                if (AnimationTime < (float)pNodeAnim->mRotationKeys[i + 1].mTime) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
    
            assert(0);
    
            return 0;
        }
    
        unsigned int FindPosition(float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < pNodeAnim->mNumPositionKeys - 1; i++) {
                if (AnimationTime < (float)pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[i + 1].mTime) {
                    return i;
                }
            }
    
            assert(0);
    
            return 0;
        }
    
        void CalcInterpolatedPosition(aiVector3D& Out, float AnimationTime, const aiNodeAnim* pNodeAnim)
        {
            if (AnimationTime <= (float)pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[0].mTime) { Out = pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[0].mValue; return; }
            if (AnimationTime >= (float)pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[pNodeAnim->mNumPositionKeys - 1].mTime) { Out = pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[pNodeAnim->mNumPositionKeys - 1].mValue; return; }
            if (pNodeAnim->mNumPositionKeys == 1) {
                Out = pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[0].mValue;
                return;
            }
    
            unsigned int PositionIndex = FindPosition(AnimationTime, pNodeAnim);
            unsigned int NextPositionIndex = (PositionIndex + 1);
            assert(NextPositionIndex < pNodeAnim->mNumPositionKeys);
            float DeltaTime = (float)(pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[NextPositionIndex].mTime - pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[PositionIndex].mTime);
            float Factor = (AnimationTime - (float)pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[PositionIndex].mTime) / DeltaTime;
            assert(Factor >= 0.0f && Factor <= 1.0f);
            const aiVector3D& Start = pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[PositionIndex].mValue;
            const aiVector3D& End = pNodeAnim->mPositionKeys[NextPositionIndex].mValue;
            aiVector3D Delta = End - Start;
            Out = Start + Factor * Delta;
        }
    
        // checks all material textures of a given type and loads the textures if they're not loaded yet.
        // the required info is returned as a Texture struct.
        // Textura incrustada en el .fbx: se busca por "*N" o por nombre de archivo
        unsigned int TexturaIncrustada(const char* ruta)
        {
            if (!ruta || !scene) return 0;
            auto nombre = [](std::string s) {
                for (char& c : s) { if (c == '\\') c = '/'; c = (char)tolower((unsigned char)c); }
                s = s.substr(s.find_last_of('/') + 1);
                return s.substr(0, s.find_last_of('.'));
            };
            const aiTexture* t = nullptr;
            if (ruta[0] == '*') { unsigned int i = (unsigned int)atoi(ruta + 1); if (i < scene->mNumTextures) t = scene->mTextures[i]; }
            else for (unsigned int i = 0; i < scene->mNumTextures && !t; i++)
                if (nombre(scene->mTextures[i]->mFilename.C_Str()) == nombre(ruta)) t = scene->mTextures[i];
            if (!t || t->mHeight != 0) return 0;
            int w = 0, h = 0, n = 0;
            unsigned char* datos = stbi_load_from_memory((const unsigned char*)t->pcData, (int)t->mWidth, &w, &h, &n, 0);
            if (!datos) return 0;
            GLenum formato = n == 1 ? GL_RED : (n == 3 ? GL_RGB : GL_RGBA);
            unsigned int id;
            glGenTextures(1, &id);
            glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, id);
            glPixelStorei(GL_UNPACK_ALIGNMENT, 1);
            glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, formato, w, h, 0, formato, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, datos);
            glGenerateMipmap(GL_TEXTURE_2D);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_REPEAT);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_REPEAT);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
            stbi_image_free(datos);
            return id;
        }

                        skip = true; // a texture with the same filepath has already been loaded, continue to next one. (optimization)
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if(!skip)
                {   // if texture hasn't been loaded already, load it
                    Texture texture;
                    texture.id = TexturaIncrustada(str.C_Str());
                    if (texture.id == 0) texture.id = TextureFromFile(str.C_Str(), this->directory);
                    texture.type = typeName;
                    texture.path = str.C_Str();
                    textures.push_back(texture);
                    textures_loaded.push_back(texture);  // store it as texture loaded for entire model, to ensure we won't unnecesery load duplicate textures.
                }
            }

        // render the mesh
        void Draw(Shader &shader)   // por referencia: evita copiar el shader en cada objeto
        {
            // bind appropriate textures
            unsigned int diffuseNr  = 1;
            unsigned int specularNr = 1;
            unsigned int normalNr   = 1;
            unsigned int heightNr   = 1;
            for(unsigned int i = 0; i < textures.size(); i++)
            {
                glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0 + i); // active proper texture unit before binding
                // retrieve texture number (the N in diffuse_textureN)
                string number;
                string name = textures[i].type;
                if(name == "texture_diffuse")
                    number = std::to_string(diffuseNr++);
                else if(name == "texture_specular")
                    number = std::to_string(specularNr++); // transfer unsigned int to stream
                else if(name == "texture_normal")
                    number = std::to_string(normalNr++); // transfer unsigned int to stream
                 else if(name == "texture_height")
                    number = std::to_string(heightNr++); // transfer unsigned int to stream
    
                // now set the sampler to the correct texture unit
                glUniform1i(glGetUniformLocation(shader.ID, (name + number).c_str()), i);
                // and finally bind the texture
                glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, textures[i].id);
            }
    
            // draw mesh
            glBindVertexArray(VAO);
            glDrawElements(GL_TRIANGLES, (GLsizei)indices.size(), GL_UNSIGNED_INT, 0);
            glBindVertexArray(0);
    
            // always good practice to set everything back to defaults once configured.
            glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
        }
    
        // render the mesh
        void DrawMirror(Shader shader, unsigned int texture_gl)

            glUniform1i(glGetUniformLocation(shader.ID, "renderedTexture"), 0);
            glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, texture_gl);

            glBindVertexArray(0);
    
            // always good practice to set everything back to defaults once configured.
            glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
        }

        void ActualizarPose(float segundos)

        }

        Mesh processMesh(aiMesh *mesh, const aiScene *scene)
        {
            // data to fill
            vector<Vertex> vertices;

                string bname(mesh->mBones[i]->mName.data);
                if (m_BoneMapping.count(bname)) continue;
    
                Bone newBone;
                newBone.name = mesh->mBones[i]->mName;
                newBone.offsetMatrix = aiMatrix4x4ToGlm(mesh->mBones[i]->mOffsetMatrix);
                newBone.transformation = glm::mat4(1.0f);
                for (unsigned int j = 0; j < mesh->mBones[i]->mNumWeights; j++)
                    newBone.push(mesh->mBones[i]->mWeights[j].mVertexId, mesh->mBones[i]->mWeights[j].mWeight);
    
                m_BoneMapping[bname] = (unsigned int)bones.size();
                bones.push_back(newBone);
            }
    
            // Walk through each of the mesh's vertices
            for(unsigned int i = 0; i < mesh->mNumVertices; i++)
            {
                Vertex vertex;
                glm::vec3 vector; // we declare a placeholder vector since assimp uses its own vector class that doesn't directly convert to glm's vec3 class so we transfer the data to this placeholder glm::vec3 first.
                // positions
                vector.x = mesh->mVertices[i].x;
                vector.y = mesh->mVertices[i].y;
                vector.z = mesh->mVertices[i].z;
                vertex.Position = vector;
                // normals
                if (mesh->mNormals) {
                    vector.x = mesh->mNormals[i].x;
                    vector.y = mesh->mNormals[i].y;
                    vector.z = mesh->mNormals[i].z;
                } else vector = glm::vec3(0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
                vertex.Normal = vector;
                // texture coordinates
                if(mesh->mTextureCoords[0]) // does the mesh contain texture coordinates?
                {
                    glm::vec2 vec;
                    // a vertex can contain up to 8 different texture coordinates. We thus make the assumption that we won't
                    // use models where a vertex can have multiple texture coordinates so we always take the first set (0).
                    vec.x = mesh->mTextureCoords[0][i].x;
                    vec.y = mesh->mTextureCoords[0][i].y;
                    vertex.TexCoords = vec;
                }
                else
                    vertex.TexCoords = glm::vec2(0.0f, 0.0f);
                // tangent
                if (mesh->mTangents && mesh->mBitangents) {   // solo existen si el modelo tiene UV
                    vector.x = mesh->mTangents[i].x;
                    vector.y = mesh->mTangents[i].y;
                    vector.z = mesh->mTangents[i].z;
                    vertex.Tangent = vector;
                    vector.x = mesh->mBitangents[i].x;
                    vector.y = mesh->mBitangents[i].y;
                    vector.z = mesh->mBitangents[i].z;
                    vertex.Bitangent = vector;
                } else {
                    vertex.Tangent = glm::vec3(1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
                    vertex.Bitangent = glm::vec3(0.0f, 0.0f, 1.0f);
                }
    
                // Bones
                int bcount = 0;
                for (unsigned int pb = 0; pb < MAX_NUM_BONES; pb++) {
                    vertex.IDs1[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.IDs2[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.IDs3[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.Weights1[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.Weights2[pb] = 0.0f;
                    vertex.Weights3[pb] = 0.0f;
                }
                m_NumBones = mesh->mNumBones;
                for (unsigned int j = 0; j < mesh->mNumBones; j++) {
                    string bname(mesh->mBones[j]->mName.data);
                    auto bit = m_BoneMapping.find(bname);
                    if (bit == m_BoneMapping.end()) continue;
                    float gId = (float)bit->second;
    
                    for (unsigned int k = 0; k < mesh->mBones[j]->mNumWeights; k++) {
                        unsigned int VertexID = mesh->mBones[j]->mWeights[k].mVertexId;
                        float Weight = (float)(mesh->mBones[j]->mWeights[k].mWeight);
                        if ( VertexID == i && bcount < MAX_NUM_BONES ) {
                            vertex.IDs1[bcount] = gId;
                            vertex.Weights1[bcount] = Weight;
                            bcount++;
                        }
                        if (VertexID == i && bcount >= MAX_NUM_BONES && bcount < 2*MAX_NUM_BONES) {
                            vertex.IDs2[bcount - MAX_NUM_BONES] = gId;
                            vertex.Weights2[bcount - MAX_NUM_BONES] = Weight;
                            bcount++;
                        }
                        if (VertexID == i && bcount >= 2 * MAX_NUM_BONES && bcount < 3 * MAX_NUM_BONES) {
                            vertex.IDs3[bcount - 2*MAX_NUM_BONES] = gId;
                            vertex.Weights3[bcount - 2*MAX_NUM_BONES] = Weight;
                            bcount++;
                        }
                    }
                }
                vertices.push_back(vertex);

    #version 330 core
    // Iluminacion submarina: luz solar que se absorbe con la profundidad (el rojo primero),
    // causticas, luz ambiental de hemisferio, linterna del buzo y niebla exponencial.
    // Incluye efectos preparados para las mecanicas: blanqueamiento y fantasma.
    in vec3 vPosMundo;
    in vec3 vNormal;
    in vec2 vUV;
    out vec4 FragColor;
    
    uniform sampler2D texture_diffuse1;
    uniform vec3  uTinte;
    uniform float uAlpha;
    uniform float uEmision;
    uniform float uResaltado;   // brillo del objeto bajo la mira
    uniform float uBlanqueo;    // 0..1 coral sano -> blanqueado (Zona 1)
    uniform float uFantasma;    // 0..1 animal real -> fantasma (Zona 2)
    uniform float uMuerte;      // 0..1 coral muerto cubierto de algas (Zona 1)
    uniform float uSpecPower;   // potencia especular (opaco bajo, plÃ¡stico medio, metal alto)
    uniform float uSpecInt;     // intensidad especular
    uniform float uMetalico;    // 0..1: 1 = brillo tintado por la textura
    
    uniform vec3  uCamPos;
    uniform vec3  uSolDir;
    uniform vec3  uSolColor;
    uniform vec3  uAmbArriba;
    uniform vec3  uAmbAbajo;
    uniform vec3  uNiebla;
    uniform float uDensidad;
    uniform float uCausticas;
    uniform float uSuperficieY;
    uniform float uTiempo;
    
    uniform int   uLinterna;
    uniform vec3  uLinternaPos;
    uniform vec3  uLinternaDir;
    
    vec3 colorAgua(vec3 d)
    {
        vec3 c = mix(uNiebla * 0.35, uNiebla, smoothstep(-0.7, 0.05, d.y));
        return mix(c, uNiebla * 1.35 + vec3(0.03), smoothstep(0.05, 0.9, d.y));
    }
    
    float hash3(vec3 p) { return fract(sin(dot(p, vec3(127.1, 311.7, 74.7))) * 43758.5453); }
    float ruido3(vec3 p)
    {
        vec3 i = floor(p), f = fract(p);
        f = f * f * (3.0 - 2.0 * f);
        return mix(mix(mix(hash3(i), hash3(i + vec3(1, 0, 0)), f.x), mix(hash3(i + vec3(0, 1, 0)), hash3(i + vec3(1, 1, 0)), f.x), f.y),
                   mix(mix(hash3(i + vec3(0, 0, 1)), hash3(i + vec3(1, 0, 1)), f.x), mix(hash3(i + vec3(0, 1, 1)), hash3(i + vec3(1, 1, 1)), f.x), f.y), f.z);
    }
    
    float causticas(vec2 p, float t)
    {
        vec2 q = p * 0.55;
        float c = 0.0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            q += vec2(sin(q.y * 1.7 + t * 0.8), cos(q.x * 1.3 + t * 0.6)) * 0.9;
            c += 1.0 / (1.0 + 14.0 * abs(sin(q.x + q.y) * cos(q.x - q.y)));
        }
        return pow(c / 3.0, 2.5);
    }
    
    void main()
    {
        vec4 tex = texture(texture_diffuse1, vUV);
        if (tex.a < 0.5) discard;   // recorte: partes transparentes del PNG (abanico de mar, hojas...)
        vec3 base = tex.rgb * uTinte;
        float gris = dot(tex.rgb, vec3(0.333));
        // Blanqueamiento por manchas: el coral pierde color en zonas irregulares que crecen
        if (uBlanqueo > 0.0 || uMuerte > 0.0) {
            float n = ruido3(vPosMundo * 3.0) * 0.65 + ruido3(vPosMundo * 9.0) * 0.35;
            float b = smoothstep(n - 0.12, n + 0.12, uBlanqueo * 1.3 - 0.15);
            base = mix(base, vec3(0.97, 0.96, 0.93) * (0.82 + 0.25 * gris), b);
            float m = smoothstep(n - 0.15, n + 0.15, uMuerte * 1.3 - 0.15);
            vec3 algas = mix(vec3(0.40, 0.38, 0.30), vec3(0.28, 0.34, 0.20), ruido3(vPosMundo * 14.0)) * (0.75 + 0.4 * gris);
            base = mix(base, algas, m);
        }
    
        vec3 N = normalize(vNormal);
        if (!gl_FrontFacing) N = -N;
        vec3 V = normalize(uCamPos - vPosMundo);
        vec3 L = normalize(-uSolDir);
    
        // el agua absorbe primero el rojo, luego el verde
        float prof = max(uSuperficieY - vPosMundo.y, 0.0);
        vec3 absorcion = exp(-prof * vec3(0.09, 0.035, 0.022));
    
        float dif = max(dot(N, L), 0.0);
        float caus = uCausticas * causticas(vPosMundo.xz, uTiempo) * max(N.y, 0.0);
        vec3 H = normalize(L + V);
        vec3 F0 = mix(vec3(0.04), base, uMetalico);   // dielÃ©ctrico vs metal
        float spec = pow(max(dot(N, H), 0.0), uSpecPower) * uSpecInt;
        vec3 specC = F0 * spec;
        vec3 amb = mix(uAmbAbajo, uAmbArriba, N.y * 0.5 + 0.5);
    
        vec3 color = base * (amb + uSolColor * absorcion * (dif * 0.85 + caus * 1.6)) + uSolColor * absorcion * specC;
    
        if (uLinterna == 1) {
            vec3 Lf = uLinternaPos - vPosMundo;
            float d = length(Lf);
            Lf /= d;
            float cono = smoothstep(0.80, 0.95, dot(-Lf, normalize(uLinternaDir)));
            float aten = 1.0 / (1.0 + 0.006 * d * d);
            color += base * vec3(1.0, 0.93, 0.78) * cono * aten * (0.3 + max(dot(N, Lf), 0.0)) * 3.2;
        }
        color += base * uEmision;
    
        float alpha = tex.a * uAlpha;
        if (uFantasma > 0.0) {
            float borde = pow(1.0 - max(dot(N, V), 0.0), 2.0);
            vec3 g = vec3(0.55, 0.90, 1.0) * (0.20 + borde * 1.6);
            color = mix(color, g, uFantasma);
            alpha = mix(alpha, 0.20 + borde * 0.7, uFantasma);
        }
        color += vec3(0.25, 0.55, 0.65) * uResaltado;
    
        // niebla submarina: el color hacia el que se pierde depende de hacia donde se mira
        float dist = length(uCamPos - vPosMundo);
        float f = 1.0 - exp(-pow(dist * uDensidad, 1.5));
        color = mix(color, colorAgua(-V), f);
    
        FragColor = vec4(color, alpha);
    }

        static int Visibles(const Elemento& e)

        void DibujarElemento(const Elemento& e, int idx, float t)
        {
            glm::vec3 tinte = e.tinte;

            }

            sh->setFloat("uSpecPower", e.specPower);
            sh->setFloat("uSpecInt", e.specInt);
            sh->setFloat("uMetalico", e.metalico);
            sh->setFloat("uVelNado", e.velNado);
            sh->setFloat("uBlanqueo", e.blanqueo);
            sh->setFloat("uMuerte", e.muerte);
            sh->setInt("uOndulaEje", e.ondulaVertical ? 1 : 0);
            sh->setFloat("uFantasma", e.fantasma);
            sh->setFloat("uResaltado", idx == seleccion ? 0.25f + 0.15f * sinf(t * 6.0f) : 0.0f);
            sh->setFloat("uVelNado", e.velNado * (0.4f + 0.6f * velFauna));
            for (int k = 0; k < Visibles(e); k++) {
                glm::mat4 M = Matriz(e, idx, k, t);
                if (!EnVista(glm::vec3(M[3]), e.radioBase * EscalaMax(M) * 1.15f)) continue;
                sh->setFloat("uFase", e.fase + k * 1.3f);
                sh->setMat4("model", M);
                e.modelo->Draw(*sh, e.modelo->TieneAnimacion() ? t + e.fase + k * 0.37f : -1.0f);
            }
        }

    #version 330 core
    // Agua de fondo: color segun la direccion de la mirada, brillo del sol y rayos de luz.
    out vec4 FragColor;
    
    uniform mat4  uInvVP;      // inversa de (proyeccion * vista sin traslacion)
    uniform vec2  uRes;
    uniform vec3  uNiebla;
    uniform vec3  uSolDir;
    uniform vec3  uSolColor;
    uniform float uTiempo;
    uniform float uProfCam;    // metros bajo la superficie
    
    vec3 colorAgua(vec3 d)
    {
        vec3 c = mix(uNiebla * 0.35, uNiebla, smoothstep(-0.7, 0.05, d.y));
        return mix(c, uNiebla * 1.35 + vec3(0.03), smoothstep(0.05, 0.9, d.y));
    }
    
    void main()
    {
        vec2 ndc = gl_FragCoord.xy / uRes * 2.0 - 1.0;
        vec4 p = uInvVP * vec4(ndc, 1.0, 1.0);
        vec3 d = normalize(p.xyz / p.w);
        vec3 c = colorAgua(d);
    
        vec3 L = normalize(-uSolDir);
        float s = max(dot(d, L), 0.0);
        float vis = exp(-uProfCam * 0.05);
        c += uSolColor * (pow(s, 90.0) * 0.6 + pow(s, 10.0) * 0.12) * vis;
    
        // rayos de luz que convergen hacia el sol
        vec3 a = normalize(cross(L, vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)));
        vec3 b = cross(L, a);
        float ang = atan(dot(d, b), dot(d, a));
        float r = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(ang * 17.0 + uTiempo * 0.30), 8.0) * 0.6
                + pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(ang * 9.0 - uTiempo * 0.21 + 1.0), 10.0) * 0.5;
        r *= smoothstep(0.15, 0.95, s);
        c += uSolColor * r * 0.10 * vis;
    
        FragColor = vec4(c, 1.0);
    }

        // Esparce 'n' copias de un elemento fijo alrededor de un centro
        void Esparcir(Elemento base, int n, glm::vec2 centro, float rMin, float rMax, float escMin, float escMax, int semilla, const std::vector<glm::vec3>& tintes = {})
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                Elemento e = base;
                float a = Aleatorio(semilla, i) * 6.2832f;
                float r = rMin + (rMax - rMin) * sqrtf(Aleatorio(semilla + 1, i));
                e.pos = glm::vec3(centro.x + cosf(a) * r, base.pos.y, centro.y + sinf(a) * r);
                e.yaw = Aleatorio(semilla + 2, i) * 360.0f;
                e.escala = escMin + (escMax - escMin) * Aleatorio(semilla + 3, i);
                e.fase = Aleatorio(semilla + 4, i) * 6.28f;
                if (!tintes.empty()) e.tinte = tintes[i % tintes.size()];
                elementos.push_back(e);
            }
        }

    uniform float uTiempo;
    uniform float uOndula;    // amplitud de la ondulacion (metros); 0 = rigido
    uniform float uLargo;     // medio largo del modelo (la cabeza esta en +X)
    uniform float uVelNado;   // velocidad de la ondulacion
    uniform float uMecer;     // vaiven de algas y abanicos
    uniform float uFase;
    uniform int   uOndulaEje;  // 0 = cola de lado a lado (peces), 1 = de arriba a abajo (mamiferos)
    uniform int   uSkinning;   // 1 = aplicar huesos de la armadura
    uniform mat4  gBones[50];
    
    out vec3 vPosMundo;
    out vec3 vNormal;
    out vec2 vUV;
    
    void main()
    {
        vec3 p = aPos;
        vec3 normal = aNormal;
        if (uSkinning != 0) {
            mat4 huesos = gBones[int(bIDs1[0])] * bWeights1[0];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs1[1])] * bWeights1[1];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs1[2])] * bWeights1[2];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs1[3])] * bWeights1[3];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs2[0])] * bWeights2[0];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs2[1])] * bWeights2[1];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs2[2])] * bWeights2[2];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs2[3])] * bWeights2[3];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs3[0])] * bWeights3[0];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs3[1])] * bWeights3[1];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs3[2])] * bWeights3[2];
            huesos += gBones[int(bIDs3[3])] * bWeights3[3];
            float peso = dot(bWeights1, vec4(1.0)) + dot(bWeights2, vec4(1.0)) + dot(bWeights3, vec4(1.0));
            if (peso > 0.0001) {
                huesos *= 1.0 / peso;
                p = (huesos * vec4(aPos, 1.0)).xyz;
                normal = mat3(huesos) * aNormal;
            }
        }
        if (uOndula > 0.0) {
            // 0 en la cabeza, 1 en la cola: la cola se mueve mas que la cabeza
            float t = clamp((uLargo - p.x) / (2.0 * uLargo), 0.0, 1.0);
            float w = uOndula * pow(t, 1.6) * uLargo;
            float onda = w * sin(p.x / uLargo * 3.0 - uTiempo * uVelNado + uFase);
            if (uOndulaEje == 1) p.y += onda; else p.z += onda;
        }
        if (uMecer > 0.0) {
            float h = max(p.y, 0.0);
            p.x += sin(uTiempo * 0.9 + uFase + h * 0.7) * uMecer * h * 0.10;
            p.z += cos(uTiempo * 0.7 + uFase + h * 0.5) * uMecer * h * 0.07;
        }
        vec4 mundo = model * vec4(p, 1.0);
        vPosMundo = mundo.xyz;
        vNormal = normalize(mat3(transpose(inverse(model))) * normal);
        vUV = aTexCoords;
        gl_Position = projection * view * mundo;
    }
    #ifndef MODEL_H
    #define MODEL_H
    
    #include <glm/gtx/string_cast.hpp>
    
    #include <modelstructs.h>
    
    class Model
    {
    public:
        /*  Model Data */
        vector<Texture> textures_loaded;    // stores all the textures loaded so far, optimization to make sure textures aren't loaded more than once.
        vector<Mesh> meshes;
        string directory;
        bool gammaCorrection;
    
        string filename;
    
        /* Bones data */
        vector<Bone> bones;
    
        static const int MAX_BONES_MODEL = 50;
        glm::mat4 m_Bones[MAX_BONES_MODEL];
        unsigned int m_BoneShaderID = 0;
        GLint m_BoneLocations[MAX_BONES_MODEL];
        double m_AnimDuracion = 0.0;
        double m_AnimFps = 24.0;
    
        /* Scene data */
        Assimp::Importer importer;
        const aiScene* scene = nullptr;
    
        map<string, unsigned int> m_BoneMapping; // maps a bone name to its index
        unsigned int m_NumBones;
        vector<BoneInfo> m_BoneInfo;
        glm::mat4 m_GlobalInverseTransform;
        unsigned int texture_gl;
        unsigned int rbo_gl;
        unsigned int framebuffer_gl;
        unsigned int IDforPicking;
    
        /*  Functions   */
        // constructor, expects a filepath to a 3D model.
        Model(string const &path, unsigned int id = 0, bool gamma = false) : gammaCorrection(gamma)
        {
            IDforPicking = id;
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BONES_MODEL; i++) {
                m_Bones[i] = glm::mat4(1.0f);
                m_BoneLocations[i] = -1;
            }
            loadModel(path);
        }
    
        bool TieneAnimacion() const { return scene && scene->mNumAnimations > 0; }
    
        void ActualizarPose(float segundos)
        {
            if (!TieneAnimacion()) return;
            double total = m_AnimDuracion > 0.0 ? m_AnimDuracion : 1.0;
            double t = std::fmod((double)segundos * m_AnimFps, total);
            if (t < 0.0) t += total;
            SetPose((float)t);
        }
    
        // draws the model, and thus all its meshes
        void Draw(Shader &shader, float animSegundos = -1.0f)   // por referencia: evita copiar el shader en cada objeto
        {
            bool animar = animSegundos >= 0.0f && TieneAnimacion();
            shader.setInt("uSkinning", animar ? 1 : 0);
            if (animar) {
                ActualizarPose(animSegundos);
                SubirHuesos(shader);
            }
            for(unsigned int i = 0; i < meshes.size(); i++)
                meshes[i].Draw(shader);
        }
    
        bool renderFramebufferToTexture() {
            //glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
    
            glDeleteTextures(1, &texture_gl);
            glDeleteFramebuffers(1, &framebuffer_gl);
            glDeleteRenderbuffers(1, &rbo_gl);
            glActiveTexture(GL_TEXTURE0);
            // Generate texture
            glGenTextures(1, &texture_gl);
            glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, texture_gl);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_S, GL_REPEAT);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_WRAP_T, GL_REPEAT);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
            glTexParameteri(GL_TEXTURE_2D, GL_TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, GL_LINEAR);
            glTexImage2D(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0, GL_RGB, 1024, 768, 0, GL_RGB, GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE, nullptr);
            glBindTexture(GL_TEXTURE_2D, 0);
    
            // Generate RBO
    
            glGenRenderbuffers(1, &rbo_gl);
            glBindRenderbuffer(GL_RENDERBUFFER, rbo_gl);
            glRenderbufferStorage(GL_RENDERBUFFER, GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8, 1024, 768);
    
    
            glGenFramebuffers(1, &framebuffer_gl);
            glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, framebuffer_gl);
            glFramebufferTexture2D(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, GL_TEXTURE_2D, texture_gl, 0);
            glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_DEPTH_ATTACHMENT, GL_RENDERBUFFER, rbo_gl);
            glFramebufferRenderbuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, GL_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT, GL_RENDERBUFFER, rbo_gl);
    
            GLenum status = glCheckFramebufferStatus(GL_FRAMEBUFFER);
            if (status != GL_FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE)
            {
                // Restore current framebuffer
                glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
                return false;
            }
    
            glBindFramebuffer(GL_FRAMEBUFFER, 0);
    
            return true;
    
        }
    
        // draws the model, and thus all its meshes
        void DrawMirror(Shader shader)
        {
    
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < meshes.size(); i++)
                meshes[i].DrawMirror(shader, texture_gl);
        }
    
        // update transformations in time
        void SetPose(float time) { SetPose(time, m_Bones); }
    
        void SetPose(float time, glm::mat4 *gBones) {
            if (!TieneAnimacion()) {
                for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BONES_MODEL; i++) gBones[i] = glm::mat4(1.0f);
                return;
            }
    
            // processNode(scene->mRootNode, time);
            glm::mat4 n_matrix(1.0f);
            ReadNodeHierarchy(time, scene->mRootNode, n_matrix);
    
            for (unsigned int i = 0; i < bones.size() && i < MAX_BONES_MODEL; i++)
                gBones[i] = bones[i].transformation;
            for (unsigned int i = (unsigned int)bones.size(); i < MAX_BONES_MODEL; i++)
                gBones[i] = glm::mat4(1.0f);
        }
    
        void SubirHuesos(Shader &shader) {
            if (m_BoneShaderID != shader.ID) {
                m_BoneShaderID = shader.ID;
                for (int i = 0; i < MAX_BONES_MODEL; i++) {
                    string nombre = "gBones[" + std::to_string(i) + "]";
                    m_BoneLocations[i] = glGetUniformLocation(shader.ID, nombre.c_str());
                }
            }
            if (m_BoneLocations[0] != -1)
                glUniformMatrix4fv(m_BoneLocations[0], MAX_BONES_MODEL, GL_FALSE, &m_Bones[0][0][0]);
        }
    
        // Return the duration of the animation in ticks (frames)
        double getNumFrames() {
            if (!TieneAnimacion()) return -1.0;
            const aiAnimation* pAnimation = scene->mAnimations[0];
            if (pAnimation == nullptr) return -1.0;
            return pAnimation->mDuration;
        }
    
        // return the number of ticks per second
        double getFramerate() {
            if (!TieneAnimacion()) return -1.0;
            const aiAnimation* pAnimation = scene->mAnimations[0];
            if (pAnimation == nullptr) return -1.0;
            return pAnimation->mTicksPerSecond;
        }
    
    private:
    
        /*  Functions   */
